decisions.reason: The temporary women's-clothing category and later recategorization apply specifically to the website listing; the TikTok Shop listing rules remain unchanged.
The source changes website categorization after product selection and does not alter CJ product research or selection criteria.
The source does not require the spreadsheet to record temporary or corrected website categories and leaves its cross-channel tracking structure unchanged.
Website product categorization is unrelated to completing and exposing the CRM structure document.
The source gives a product-listing instruction but does not change the fallback rule for independently selecting work when blocked.
The source refines one Shopify listing behavior but does not change the current assignment set, deadline, or recurring completion rules.
The Shopify category instruction has no effect on the cadence or behavior of Airbnb host outreach.
The source does not concern interested Airbnb host conversations or their next-step guidance.
The website product-category change does not alter where or how interested Airbnb leads are recorded.
The source does not change the storage destination or completeness rules for task artifacts.
The product categorization instruction does not change how ClickUp subtasks or goal parent tasks must be marked.
The source concerns Shopify product categorization and does not modify the content bank, its intended use, or its deadline.
